decision: Counted the work: about 10 units (arms, touch buttons, safe area, physics controller, park, vault, ledge grab, landing tiers and roll, ragdoll and get-up, ramp objects), each with tests and a commit
why: Wanted the size and the order before a long run
result: baseline committed, 11 logic tests green before changes

decision: Ragdoll will be a particle and constraint solver in game code that collides through the engine's physics queries
why: The engine's Rapier wrapper exposes bodies, colliders, a capsule controller and queries, but no joints

decision: Sprint and Jump became custom round canvas buttons, not native glass buttons
why: Only a canvas button can hold an action, and a native glass button cannot be a canvas child; the user asked for hold
result: contract compiles, 3 web tests and 12 logic tests green
